metric: KL(P_ref || P_ckpt) in nats, ref = the checkpoint's own-family intact (r1_intact / r2_intact; every arm also vs bf16_base). kl_prompt_last: next-token distribution at the last prompt position (prompt ends '<think>\n', enable_thinking=True). kl_teacher_forced: mean over the first 32 generated positions teacher-forcing the r1_intact greedy completion tokens (transcript phase1_dim_r1); kl_teacher_forced_own: same with each family's own intact greedy tokens (r2_* on phase1_dim_r2). Float32 head, batch size 1, no padding. Gate (spec 1.2): mean over prompts < 0.10.
